summary: Pit crew worker allocator for driver a2 (called by sub_4B7500 and PitTimingUpdate 004b7a90). Skips when the driver's vehicle slot dword_5EF9A0[4656 * a2] is inactive (-1). For each of 4 worker slots, scans the pit stall circular buffer (176-byte entries) via HashTableLookup, collecting up to 12 matching entries; when at least 9 match, marks processed entries with BitfieldSetter_4800, sorts the collected entries by distance using sub_4B6360, and assigns worker data to each stall with sub_4B4A30. Returns i + 1 per slot iteration.

Iterate i over the 4 worker slots (i = 0..3).
Call CircularBufferCheck(v3) to obtain the active entry count v22 of the pit stall circular buffer.
Guard: when the circular buffer count is not positive (v22 <= 0), skip the lookup pass for this worker slot.
do-while scan over the circular buffer while v6 < v22, advancing v6 each iteration.
Compute the candidate entry index v7 = v3[622] - v6, wrapping by adding the buffer modulus v3[621] when the difference is negative.
Call HashTableLookup on the pit stall entry at v3[620] + 176 * v7 with worker slot i and driver index a2, filling the out-flag v17.
Guard: when the lookup returns a non-null entry and the out-flag v17 is set, break the scan early.
Record the matched entry pointer into v24[v5] and its buffer index into v24[v5 + 12], then increment v5.
Guard: stop collecting once 12 entries are gathered (v5 >= 12).
Guard: only proceed with marking, sorting and assignment when at least 9 entries were collected for this slot (v18 >= 9).
for loop over the collected entries: call BitfieldSetter_4800 on each stall entry at v3[620] + 176 * v24[v10 + 12] to mark it processed.
Sort the collected entries with a two-pointer partition loop that calls sub_4B6360 to compare entries v23 and v24[v11].
Assignment pass: while v11 > v14, call sub_4B4A30 to assign the collected worker data to the stall entry at v3[620] + 176 * v24[v11 + 12], then decrement v11.
Return i + 1 at the end of each worker-slot iteration.
